title: Don't miss this
text: This was such a fun thing to do! I try to do something like this everywhere I travel. It makes what I bring back much more meaningful. The staff is phenomenal  and they keep things light and fun, but they know their stuff. The cocktails are yummy and it is gratifying to bring something home that you made. Everything in the store is handmade they even have really tiny espadrilles. On your trip to Barcelona, take two hours to relax and use the creative part of your brain, you won't regret it!
author: Tania_A

title: Fun and interesting
text: This was such a fun creative experience. Our host/teacher was Jordy, who was so friendly and funny. He helped us design beautiful raffia bags. We all had fun, ages 12-47. Would definitely recommend and do again.

title: 100% recommendable! It’s...
text: 100% recommendable! It’s an interesting experience with kind artisans that explained everything in detail and with a lot of patience. On top of that, at the end of the experience, you will bring home a beautiful raffia bag with you.

title: Loved this experience!...
text: Loved this experience! The hosts were quite charismatic and we had lots of fun. I would truly recommend this to my friends and family. The artisans created an amazing atmosphere and you get to make your own bag. Will totally recommend it.
author: Esther_M

title: Very fun, but come “prepared” with an idea
text: I overall liked the experience and am satisfied with my bag. The team is very nice and accommodating to one’s wishes! I personally would have appreciated a little more guidance. The workshop started with the question what we want to make. There were some examples in the store but all of the same style/technique. I found it hard to come up with an idea on the spot, and quickly Googled some options. I wished I was instructed to do that beforehand.
